broader_coverage.reasoning: Global SSA forbidding every loop distance is strictly stronger than forbidding just loop distance one, so its capacity upper bound cannot supply an exact count of this larger language. The >=k statement of Zhang–Wu excludes distant occurrences but allows shorter loops, and is not a fixed exactly-one loop enumeration. Neither dominates the present equality statement.

value.rationale: PASS: The exact one-unpaired-letter stem is the first strictly positive local loop model distinct from immediate reverse-complement block adjacency. A uniform all-even-alphabet rational enumeration, a fifth-order recurrence and a DNA finite-state growth constant make the exact constraint capacity computable for every length. The mathematical benchmark aids comparison with longer-loop and global constraints. No biological efficacy or large-stem performance is asserted.
